data.title: Can Quantum Computers Break Bitcoin? An Ethereum Researcher Just Told Big Holders to Prepare for Bunker Mode
data.description: An Ethereum Foundation researcher just urged big holders to prepare for bunker mode, and the threat triggering his warning has nothing to do with quantum computers. The real danger could arrive in months, and about a third of all Bitcoin supply sits fully exposed.
